title: How Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, Demi Moore and Adriana Lima Prepped Their Skin for the Spotlight
summary: From high-tech sculpting devices to 24-karat gold masks, celebrity facialists Mimi Luzon, Keren Bartov and Shani Darden share the treatments behind Hollywood’s biggest stars at the Academy Museum Gala and Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show.

extraction.key_fact: 유명 페이셜 전문가들이 할리우드 스타들의 피부 관리 시술을 공개했다.
